import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Main instance = new Main();
        instance.runProgram();
    }

    private void runProgram() {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        
        int[] sequence = new int[n];
        int[] prefixParity = new int[n];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sequence[i] = scanner.nextInt();
            if (i == 0) {
                prefixParity[i] = (sequence[i] & 1) == 0 ? 1 : -1;
            } else {
                prefixParity[i] = prefixParity[i-1] + ((sequence[i] & 1) == 0 ? 1 : -1);
            }
        }
        
        PriorityQueue<Transition> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n-1; i++) {
            int diff = Math.abs(sequence[i+1] - sequence[i]);
            pq.offer(new Transition(diff, i));
        }
        
        int operations = 0;
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            Transition t = pq.poll();
            if (k >= t.cost && prefixParity[t.index] == 0) {
                k -= t.cost;
                operations++;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(operations);
    }
    
    static class Transition implements Comparable<Transition> {
        int cost;
        int index;
        
        Transition(int c, int idx) {
            cost = c;
            index = idx;
        }
        
        @Override
        public int compareTo(Transition other) {
            if (cost != other.cost) return Integer.compare(cost, other.cost);
            return Integer.compare(index, other.index);
        }
    }
}
